title: No Matter How: Concessive Generalizations (bárhogyan is)
grammar: Universal concessive clauses with bárki, bármi, bárhogyan, bármennyire is + subjunctive/indicative
goal: I can form universal concessive clauses with bárki, bármi, bárhol, bárhogyan, and bármennyire is.
I can place the enclitic particle 'is' immediately after the finite verb or predicate.
I can choose between indicative (real/factual) and subjunctive (hypothetical/open) moods in bár- clauses.

sections.title: Unit 9: Logic, Paradox & Abstract Reasoning
body: Abstract reasoning, formal logic, and philosophical debate often require stating that a conclusion holds true across all possible cases—no matter who acts, regardless of how intensely one tries, or whether condition A or condition B obtains.

Hungarian distinguishes two series of free-choice and concessive pronouns: the 'bár-' series (bárki, bármi, bárhogyan, bármennyire is) and the 'akár-' series (akárki, akármi, akárhogy, plus the disjunctive pair 'akár... akár...'). Through István Örkény's razor-sharp Egyperces novellák (One-Minute Stories, 1968), where bureaucratic rules and everyday logic collide in brilliant paradoxes, you will master the syntax of deduction and contradiction.
